Embodied First Exam: agent runs
	

Paper: arXiv:2611.12177 · Website: embodied-first-exam.ai · Code: GitHub
The agent runs behind the run viewer of the Embodied First Exam, an agentic
robotics benchmark that tests coding agents on 1,156 robot tasks in 35 suites with 47 robots: every step, tool call and picture an agent saw while it sat a task, the verifier's replay of
its final answer, and the agent's full trajectory for download.
